name: show_changes
description: Show all file changes recorded in the current session (plus optional git diff fallback). Returns a compact summary with per-file status and a unified diff snippet. Use this before concluding a task to verify modifications. Includes the persistent session mutation revision and current/stale command verification gaps. Checks cover only the recorded command scope, not semantic correctness; request verification_details for provenance and evidence locators.

path.description: Optional file path filter — when set, only changes touching this path (substring match) are shown.

include_git.description: When true (default), include `git diff`/`git status` as fallback when the session mutation log is empty. Set false to show only explicit session writes/patches.

limit_snippet.description: Maximum characters of the change summary to include (default 120 means 9600 characters; 0 disables this truncation, but the summary itself is still capped at 14,000 characters and the git fallback at 32,768 diff bytes).

verification_details.description: Include whole latest command observations with revision coverage, status, origin/poll call IDs and evidence locators (default false). Defaults to 8 checks and 8192 bytes per page; checks_page reports shown/total counts and the next page.

verification_offset.description: Start at this latest-check index when verification_details is true (default 0). Pagination uses the current committed snapshot; verify revision and observation IDs if commands or mutations run between pages.

verification_limit.description: Maximum whole verification checks per page (default 8; 0 disables the count cap).

verification_max_bytes.description: Maximum pretty-printed verification.checks array bytes per page (default 8192; 0 disables the byte cap). Nonzero budgets are normalized to at least 2 bytes for the empty array; checks_page.max_bytes reports the effective cap. An oversized next observation is omitted whole, with next_check_bytes and a hint to lift this cap.

verification_full.description: Return all latest verification checks from the current committed snapshot, enabling details and ignoring offset/count/byte caps (default false).
